name: Until the Universe Explodes
source:
A kinetic visual novel/character study about two coworkers fleeing from a dystopian regime in a cyberpunk-ish setting due to the discovery of their underground revolutionary zine. Stuck in a storage crate with no one but each other, the girls are put into an intimate situation like they have never been before, reminiscing the past, present, and future - whether it be together or apart. 

[From [url=https://bunibonbun.itch.io/until-the-universe-explodes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部动态视觉小说/人物研究，讲述了两名同事因发现地下革命杂志而逃离赛博朋克风格的反乌托邦政权的故事。女孩们被困在一个储物箱里，除了彼此之外没有人，女孩们被置于一种前所未有的亲密情境中，回忆过去、现在和未来——无论是在一起还是分开。

[来自[url=https://bunibonbun.itch.io/until-the-universe-explodes]Itch.io[/url]]
